metadata.title: The AI Trade Is Looking Wobbly. These 2 Stocks Will Benefit From Increased Volatility.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The AI Trade Is Looking Wobbly. These 2 Stocks Will Benefit From Increased Volatility.
As the stock market alternatively displays the grace of a boxer and the oafishness of a drunkard, investors are once more confronting that which they fear most: volatility.
